title: unified-rollouts: enhanced shadow/canary auto-rollback and probing improvements
author: Priya Kapoor
description: Motivation: improve safety and observability of staged rollouts by extending the shadow+canary autorollback engine with metric-probing, transient-failure tolerance, and clearer observability hooks. This PR implements a probing pass that runs lightweight shadow probes before increasing canary weight, adds multi-metric threshold evaluation with configurable windowing, and introduces safety guards to avoid noisy alerts from transient spikes. Key changes include: 1) a new probing scheduler that runs pre-rollout checks against representative routes, 2) enhancements to the autorollback engine to support composite metrics and min-stable-window semantics, 3) improved tracing and per-route rollout dashboards, and 4) e2e and integration tests that simulate latency and error-rate regressions. Checklist: [x] design doc linked (ENG-4321) [x] unit tests added [x] e2e tests covering probe/rollback scenarios [x] observability dashboards updated [x] feature-flag gated behind rollout.experimental.shadow_canary_probing. Why now: incidents in Q3 showed rollouts occasionally tripped on transient errors; the probing and stable-window semantics reduce false positives and make rollouts safer for high-throughput routes. Backwards compatibility: defaults preserve current behavior unless the experimental flag is enabled. Rollout plan: feature gated, small canary in staging for 48h before gradual ramp to production. See linked Linear items for rollout tasks.
